name: Roman Kingdom & Republic

name: Frankish & Carolingian Empire
summary: Out of the Germanic kingdoms succeeding Western Rome, the Franks united Western and Central Europe under Charlemagne, sparking the Carolingian Renaissance before splitting in the Treaty of Verdun (843) into the precursors of France and Germany.
keyFacts: Carolingian minuscule script (basis of modern lowercase alphabet)
